skill.summary: AWP (Agent Work Protocol) — the complete toolkit for agent mining on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and BSC. Use this skill when the user explicitly mentions AWP,...

latestVersion.changelog:
AWP skill 1.7.0 — Adds support for new wallet unlock flows and API enhancements.

- Compatible with new awp-wallet versions: unlocking is now optional, session token (`--token`) is no longer required unless using older wallets.
- API adds `staking.getPending` for querying pending allocations.
- API notes: `nonce.get` and `nonce.getStaking` may lag behind on-chain state; on-chain queries preferred for signing.
- Documentation and requirements updated to reflect new wallet behavior and API changes.
